updates.title: RC cars, better sync and smoother CEF
updates.description:
• RC cars now work like on PC: you can get out, you return to where you started, and other players see you standing there while you drive.
• Many sync fixes so other players look the same as on PC: damage, bullets, empty cars, towing, passengers, horn and sirens.
• Satchel charges no longer crash the game.
• New "PC draw distance" option, and the world looks sharp right after you spawn.
• Servers with CEF screens run smoother. New options: "Smooth CEF" and "Keep buttons visible".
• Damaged train files no longer crash the game while loading.
• New launcher settings design with clear groups and new switches.

updates.title: Stability and sharper graphics
updates.description:
• Fixed many crashes while loading and while playing, especially with damaged game files or custom models.
• The launcher checks your game files and can repair them for you.
• Textures far away look sharper and smoother.
• Steering keeps working when you hold another button with a second finger.
• Works on more phones and graphics chips.
• Better protection for the game code.

updates.title: PC experience update
updates.description:
• Sync rebuilt to work like PC SA-MP 0.3.7: cars, damage, explosions, planes, trailers and empty cars now behave the same for everyone.
• PC-style options: PC HUD, PC camera, PC brightness, widescreen view, PC gun strafe and extra lights.
• Custom vehicle models with downloads, tuning, lights and engine sounds.
• SA-MP map buildings, like the LS office tower and BeachSide, load like on PC.
• Chat in many languages, including Russian, Arabic, Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese, with a built-in keyboard language switch.
• Mod Manager: turn skins, weapon icons, animations, sounds and buttons on or off.
• TAB scoreboard button, and CEF screens that fit every phone.
• Support for Android 16 and new phones, in both 32-bit and 64-bit.

updates.title: Rebuilt game engine
updates.description: The game was rebuilt from the ground up: GTA San Andreas now runs from its own source code inside SAMP Mobile X, the original SA-MP client files are back, and the launcher you know stays the same.

updates.title: Custom model support
updates.description: Added support for SA-MP 0.3.DL custom skins and custom models.

updates.title: UV Animation
updates.description: UV animation can now be enabled or disabled from launcher settings.

updates.title: Minify Mode
updates.description: Added an option to use packaged custom data instead of downloading server files.

updates.title: Launcher redesign
updates.description: Redesigned the launcher with a new look and layout.
